verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents connecting a local Agent on your own machine through a guided connector wizard, a desktop terminal with sessions, and running local MCP connectors. Marketing copy also claims agents were dispatched against 500 open issues. Together these hint at supervising local agents doing repo work, but none of it explicitly shows coding agents cloning, editing or testing a repository. Missing for 10: explicit docs on embedding or supervising named coding agents, documented clone/edit/test repo workflows, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
